purpose: PR #617 spec section 7.6 decision 6: at most two paired cases with an existing maintained tool to attribute the per-batch watermark cost of the convenience-stream defaults
change: feature/stream-convenience-defaults makes BoundedOutOfOrderness with emit_interval == 0 emit the generated watermark after every advancing data batch, makes that the default for convenience streams with declared event time (was a 100 ms timer), and makes convenience streams default to checkpointing off
attribution_limit: Both arms use the entrypoint defaults, so each paired delta combines checkpoint-off and per-batch watermarks. The maintained harness accepts no runtime config or watermark policy, so neither change can be pinned; the result cannot attribute between the two default changes.
third_arm: skipped: pinning StreamRuntimeConfig(checkpointing=True) on the candidate requires editing the maintained harness, and the release_pairs rule is strictly two-sided

baseline.product_build: sealed release wheel of b9a46e1266510271b63fffd2fca254659fc96607; b9a46e12..39cab2fb changes only crates/calc-flow/README.md under crates/, python/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and pyproject.toml

candidate.build_command: env -u CONDA_PREFIX .venv/bin/python scripts/profile_warm_stream.py build (release, --locked, pyo3/abi3-py313); seals recorded by the build manifest and verified before timing

harness.source: candidate checkout benchmarks/test_stream_operators.py, byte-identical to main (git diff 39cab2fb 3235ca37 -- benchmarks scripts is empty)
harness.entrypoint: program.stream(inputs) with no config and no watermark policy over a declared event-time, entity-keyed, sequence-ordered source
harness.timing_scope: program-stream-lifecycle-to-arrow: compilation, fresh native job, source delivery, watermarks, output conversion and completion; fixture construction, batch splitting and output validation outside timing

rule.source: scripts.benchmark_suite.release_pairs collect_case ordering and scripts.benchmark_suite.report.comparison verdict
rule.order: adjacent AB/BA alternating, one fresh pytest process per invocation
rule.observation: median of the invocation's saved pytest-benchmark raw samples under the harness's declared min_rounds=3, max_time=1.0
rule.verdict: regression only when both round 95% paired-median lower bounds exceed +5%; inconclusive when an upper bound exceeds +5% otherwise; improved when both upper bounds are below -5%; otherwise no-confirmed-regression (not equivalence)
rule.identity_deviation: release_collectors.python_observation and release_pairs.evaluate_case call identity.validate_identity, which rejects this harness's rows because extra_info records input_rows/output_rows while its workload identity names the count rows_per_input. The driver instead requires every raw machine/dependency/workload identity to reproduce its SHA-256, all three fingerprints to equal the first baseline observation, scenario/scope/backend/scale to agree with the workload identity, and input_rows == output_rows == rows_per_input. Samples, order, worker uniqueness, native seals and verdict computation are unchanged.

cases.label: A
cases.workload: rolling_state (ts.mean rows(20), ts.average, ts.ewma span 20), 16 entities, 20,000 rows as 32 ordered batches (31 x 640 + 160)
cases.rationale: many small ordered batches: the candidate emits a generated watermark after each of 32 advancing batches where the baseline relies on the 100 ms timer and end of input; the most batches this maintained harness offers

cases.label: B
cases.workload: same program and 640-row batch size, 960 rows as 2 batches (640 + 320)
cases.rationale: batch-count control: per-batch watermark count drops from 32 to 2 while per-job effects of the defaults (no temporary checkpoint runtime, no timer) remain. No maintained convenience-stream harness varies batch size, so a same-row-count large-batch control is unavailable without editing a harness; this control varies batch count at fixed batch size instead

budget.includes: seal checks, wheel installs, every invocation including pytest startup, collection, harness validation runs and pytest-benchmark calibration, evaluation and cleanup
budget.excludes: the candidate release build, reported separately
budget.stop_rule: stop at the budget; an incomplete case receives no verdict; no added cases, samples or retries

environment: WSL2 on a shared host; load average and concurrent cargo/pytest/maturin processes checked immediately before timing
